title: Movie Recommendation System (Thesis)

summary.en: Development of a movie recommendation system based on dataset processing, generating movie recommendations for users using the methods applied in the thesis research.
summary.id: Pengembangan sistem rekomendasi film berbasis pengolahan dataset untuk menghasilkan rekomendasi film kepada pengguna berdasarkan metode yang diterapkan dalam penelitian skripsi.

technologies: [Recommendation Algorithm (Collaborative Filtering with Singular Value Decomposition / Content-Based Filtering with TF-IDF + Cosine Similarity / Hybrid with Weighted Average)]

overview.en: A thesis project on developing a movie recommendation system that uses a dataset as its main data source. The research covers data processing, applying the recommendation method, developing the system, and testing it to produce movie recommendations that match the research approach.
overview.id: Proyek skripsi berupa pengembangan sistem rekomendasi film dengan memanfaatkan dataset sebagai sumber data utama. Penelitian mencakup proses pengolahan data, penerapan metode rekomendasi, pengembangan sistem, serta pengujian untuk menghasilkan rekomendasi film yang sesuai dengan pendekatan penelitian.

role.en: Carried out the research and system development, including dataset collection and processing, implementation of the recommendation method, application development, and testing and evaluation of the research results.
role.id: Melakukan penelitian dan pengembangan sistem, meliputi pengumpulan dan pengolahan dataset, implementasi metode rekomendasi, pengembangan aplikasi, serta pengujian dan evaluasi hasil penelitian.

learnings.en: Understood the development process of a recommendation system.

learnings.id: Melakukan pengolahan dataset untuk kebutuhan rekomendasi.

learnings.en: Implemented recommendation algorithms according to the research method.
learnings.id: Mengimplementasikan algoritma rekomendasi sesuai metode penelitian.

learnings.en: Integrated data processing results into the application.
learnings.id: Mengintegrasikan hasil pengolahan data ke dalam aplikasi.

learnings.en: Tested and evaluated the recommendation results.
learnings.id: Melakukan pengujian dan evaluasi terhadap hasil rekomendasi.

content.en: Processing the movie dataset to prepare the data used in the recommendation system, including data adjustment and preprocessing according to the needs of the research method. Tools and techniques: [ISI].
content.id: Proses pengolahan dataset film untuk menyiapkan data yang akan digunakan dalam sistem rekomendasi, termasuk penyesuaian dan preprocessing data sesuai kebutuhan metode penelitian. Tools dan teknik: [ISI].

content.en: Implementation of the movie recommendation method to generate recommendations based on the approach and parameters used in the research. Algorithm: [ISI].
content.id: Implementasi metode rekomendasi film untuk menghasilkan rekomendasi berdasarkan pendekatan dan parameter yang digunakan dalam penelitian. Algoritma: [ISI].

content.en: Implementation of the recommendation system into an application, and testing and evaluation of the recommendation results based on the research scenarios and metrics. Framework, evaluation metrics, and testing: [ISI].
content.id: Implementasi sistem rekomendasi ke dalam aplikasi, serta pengujian dan evaluasi hasil rekomendasi berdasarkan skenario dan metrik penelitian. Framework, metrik evaluasi, dan pengujian: [ISI].
